description: Fictional sample for testing: Monsoon Bikes, an e-bike startup, over sixteen weeks of meetings, WhatsApp groups, email threads and founder notes, plus articles, tasks, customer feedback, a purchase order and a Slack thread, written in other tools' shapes. It also exercises the importer: one duplicate record, two records with no timezone, and one transcript longer than the record budget. Every company, person and event in it is made up.
